co_satellite_note: co-satellite terms sit at exactly 0 deg by P-10 (the terminal cannot resolve two beams of one satellite) and are excluded from both fractions: counting them would manufacture a disclosure out of a modelling assumption

policy.description: hold the previous association while it stays valid
policy.name: stay-if-possible

power_weighting_note: weighted over CO-COLOUR cross-satellite terms only -- the ones that actually enter I.  Weighting over all radiating beams would count power (3.12) discards, and the disclosure would be about a sum the model never forms
